correctness.rationale: For the unnormalized defining character on probability Haar SU(N), N≥3, tensor-power multiplicities are tableau counts; padded highest weights restrict to the same SU(N) character exactly when their difference is constant. The center forces r−s to be a multiple of N. At r+s=6 the diagonal moment is 1²+2²+1²=6, and the only extras, with conjugates, come from shapes (2,2,2), (2,1,1,1) paired with (1), and (1⁶); their hook products give 5, 4, and 1, respectively. The j,k terms of the two cubic expansions have trace degrees (3+j−k,3−j+k); the diagonal gives 6S³+36Spq, and the extras give 10 Re(w³), 24S Re(w²), and 2 Re(w³) at the three ranks. Writing pq=(S²−(p−q)²)/4 and |w|=√(pq) gives precisely the four nonnegative deficits. Equality means balance and, at exceptional ranks, Re(w^k)=|w|^k; a=b≠0 attains each optimum, and S=0 is trivial. Character orthogonality validates the denominator S³. RESULT.md line 88 reverses the subtraction in prose only; its displayed definition and formulas are correct. The archived finite checks were read as corroboration, not as the proof.
